summary: This component renders a custom 404 page when users land on a missing page. It extracts a search term from the failed URL, randomly picks one of five humorous meerkat-themed messages to display, and automatically opens a search tool pre-filled with that term to help users find what they were looking for.

explanations.13: The `split("/").filter(Boolean).pop()` extracts the last part of the URL path (filtering out empty strings from double slashes), so "/docs/docker-cs-fixer" becomes "docker-cs-fixer".
explanations.14: This replaces any sequence of hyphens or underscores with a space, turning "docker-cs-fixer" into "docker cs fixer" so it reads better as a search query.
explanations.20: The translation extraction tool reads the actual code structure, so each `translate()` call must be written out individually; if we looped over an array, the tool wouldn't find the translation keys.
explanations.57: The `useState` with an initializer function means this random message is picked once when the component first loads and never changes, even if the component re-renders.
explanations.59: This picks a random index between 0 and the number of messages, then uses `Math.floor()` to round down to a whole number so we get a valid array index.
explanations.63: This builds the correct image URL based on the site's base path, so the image works whether you're visiting the site at the root or in a subdirectory.
explanations.70: The `useEffect` runs after the component renders and automatically opens the command palette (search tool) with the guessed search term from the failed URL.
